verdicts.reason: A breaks the can-in-circle motif: the empty circle sits cropped at the far left and the can floats alone at the far right. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline, the CTA is shrunk to badge size in a cramped row with the badges and tiny unreadable body copy, and the middle-right is a large dead area. B reads cleanly left to right: brand and headline, then body copy and badges, then a prominent CTA, and the can stays inside its circle. Its flaws are a very small can (the label is illegible), body copy that is a little small, and an uneven gap between the copy and the CTA.
